fact_text: The KSE-100 index was near a record high of about 94,000 points in Nov 2024, after repeated new records.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: The analyst expects falling interest rates to benefit trade and industry, with the effect visible within five to six months and by the March or June fiscal year-end.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: The analyst notes that government-owned companies have become important to the KSE-100 index because they are high-weight stocks, so their moves affect the index.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: OGDC drew investor interest after gas collections improved from SNGPL and SSGC, and the analyst cites a valuation multiple of roughly 3 to 4 times for it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum (PPL) was also cited as drawing investor interest on the gas-collection theme, at a valuation multiple of roughly 3 to 4 times.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: On 4 Nov 2024 a multi-year tariff letter for K-Electric's generation business was uploaded to the NEPRA website.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: K-Electric has long sought a multi-year tariff for its transmission and distribution business, and the analyst sees a possible letter in Nov or Dec 2024 as a catalyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: If the multi-year tariff proves material, the analyst expects K-Electric's bottom-line net earnings and profitability to rise.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: The analyst expects falling interest rates to show up in PTC's earnings in later years, though the effect is not yet visible.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: Pakistan Re is on the government's privatisation list, a status the analyst says has drawn media attention.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Top 5 Government-Owned Stocks Every Investor Needs for 2024 Success' (YouTube, 2024-11-15)

fact_text: The analyst called Pakistan Re's nine-month earnings very notable, with a total investment portfolio of about 21 billion that includes equity and debt holdings such as T-bills and PIBs.
